edit.description: `scan_locus` (line 476) opens with `let root = crate::path::normalize_path(root);`, justified at the site by "a `.`-rooted locus (`root = \".\"`)" — the case the 03adbbde fold moved upstream into `Discovery::locus_root` (103). Both call sites now hand it an already-normalized root: `discover_kind_units` (469) reads `locus_root`, and `nested_file_members` (318) passes `unit.dir`, which `host_units` builds either as `unit_dir(&disc.locus_root(governs), entry)` (372) or as `found.file.parent()` off the shared index, whose every key is normalized in `discoverable_paths` (618). Drop the pass and state the precondition in its place: the index is keyed by normalized paths, so a normalized root is what matching *requires*, not a convenience the scan supplies. Correct `locus_root`'s own doc (97-98), which declares the pass kept because `scan_locus` "also runs over a host unit's directory, so it cannot presume a pre-normalized root" — that directory is itself derived from this producer and from the normalized index, so the reason names a caller shape that cannot occur.

summary: `scan_locus`'s normalize of its own root is unreachable since the locus-root fold, and the reason its doc declares for keeping it names a caller that cannot occur.

tests.asserts: `the_locus_root_joins_the_harness_and_drops_a_root_dot` and the module's nested-file and `.`-rooted discovery pins stay green with the pass removed — the root the one producer normalizes is the only root the scan is ever handed

acceptance: `cargo test` green with the pass gone — `tests/it/nested_member.rs` (the per-host-unit call site) and `tests/it/memory_gate.rs` (the `.`-rooted locus) unmodified, so the no-op is proven by the suite rather than narrated — and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean.
notes: Residue the 03adbbde fold itself made: before it, `discover_kind_units` handed `scan_locus` the raw `<harness>/<root>` join, so the pass was live. No new pin — the removal is observable at no call site, which is the entry's own claim; a test asserting the absence of a lexical pass is unwritable. If build finds a third caller the census missed, the pass stays and only the doc is corrected — say so in the body. scoped at c51c34ef
